title: Engineering Manager - App Stores
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

This is a technical management role to lead a team that develops Python and Golang micro‑services that power our global software distribution engine. The world sees it as the Snap Store and Charmhub.io marketplaces; behind the scenes it is a unified system that understands key concepts in software distribution – architectures, releases, betas, release candidates, stable releases, branches and more. We are on a journey to transform the experience that people all over the world have with their open source software by significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through this system. If you have a passion for clean APIs, believe that great engineers ship software calmly and regularly against an agile plan, and know that tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in.

This is a great opportunity to take part in engineering a highly scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical's world‑class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high‑performing team.

Location

This role may be based remotely in the Americas, Europe, Middle East or Africa time zones.

What your day will look like

  • Lead a remote team of engineers in your time zone
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands‑on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • With your team, build clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang).
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open‑source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Good experience in leading modern, agile software development practices
  • Experience in forming a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Demonstrative experience of being a role model for sound engineering principles and directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the timely delivery of high‑quality software
  • You value and nurture great team culture and spirit
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • Software development experience in Python (experience in Golang in addition to that would be a big plus)
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment – we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Your primary role is to perform integrity and corrosion analysis studies to assess current challenges and develop a mitigation plan by implementing cost effective solutions and deployment of advanced and proven technologies to prevent or significantly reduce the impact of corrosion. This is to be supported with benchmarking and implementation of strategies that will enhance the long‑term reliability and asset efficiency of our assets.

  • Review PIP trends and initiate detailed engineering studies accordingly (e.g. increase in internal corrosion features, encroachment to pipelines, low quality of ILI reports, failure investigations, etc.)

  • Perform penetration tests on PC, mobile, and console games

  • Basic web hacking knowledge

Working knowledge

  • Unreal Engine (UE4/UE5, UE4SS), Unity, dnSpy, il2cpp

Benefits

O Contratado se compromete a responder e atuar na correção de erros, bugs ou falhas críticas de produção em tempo hábil, fora do horário comercial, quando a indisponibilidade do sistema impactar diretamente a operação ou a receita da Contratante. This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

We're looking for someone who can design realistic and structured evaluation scenarios for LLM-based agents. You'll create test cases that simulate human-performed tasks and define gold-standard behavior to compare agent actions against. You'll work to ensure each scenario is clearly defined, well-scored, and easy to execute and reuse. You'll need a sharp analytical mindset, attention to detail, and an interest in how AI agents make decisions.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Create structured test cases that simulate complex human workflows
  • Define gold-standard behavior and scoring logic to evaluate agent actions.
  • Analyze agent logs, failure modes, and decision paths
  • Work with code repositories and test frameworks to validate your scenarios
  • Iterate on prompts, instructions, and test cases to improve clarity and difficulty
  • Ensure that scenarios are production‑ready, easy to run, and reusable

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's and/or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Background in QA, software testing, data analysis, or NLP annotation
  • Good understanding of test design principles (e.g., reproducibility, coverage, edge cases)
  • Strong written communication skills in English
  • Comfortable with structured formats like JSON/YAML for scenario description
  • Can define expected agent behaviors (gold paths) and scoring logic
  • Basic experience with Python and JS
  • Curious and open to working with AI-generated content, agent logs, and prompt‑based behavior

Nice to Have

  • Experience in writing manual or automated test cases
  • Familiarity with LLM capabilities and typical failure modes
  • Understanding of scoring metrics (precision, recall, coverage, reward functions)

Benefits

Contribute on your own schedule, from anywhere in the world. This opportunity allows you to:

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

title: Cloud Engineer - Kubernetes (Home Office)
description:
Kubernetes Engineer

ITTConnect is seeking a Kubernetes Engineer to work remotely for one of our clients. This is a role with a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.

Job location

Remote, work anywhere from Brazil.

English language requirement

This job requires excellent English, written and spoken. Please submit a resume in English and be prepared for English language interviews throughout the process.

Overview

The Kubernetes Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, operating, and securing our client's container platforms, with a focus on Kubernetes-based PaaS (Platform as a Service) environments. This role ensures high availability, performance, security, and lifecycle management of Kubernetes platforms across Lab, Non-Prod, and Production environments. The Kubernetes Engineer works cross‑functionally with cloud, cybersecurity, compute, network, and application teams to deliver resilient and automated platform services aligned with Product Management and CCOE strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Engineering & Operations

  • Design, build, and operate Kubernetes clusters (on‑prem and/or cloud) following standard reference architectures.
  • Implement and maintain Kubernetes add‑ons, CSI storage drivers, CNI network plugins, and ingress controllers.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability of Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
  • Perform lifecycle upgrades of Kubernetes, OS, infrastructure software (GKE, Rancher), and supporting components.
  • Manage persistent storage solutions including migration to Dell CSI‑enabled PowerStore and Portworx.
  • Manage hardware lifecycle work for Kubernetes‑backed compute environments.

Security, Compliance & Cybersecurity Alignment

  • Implement and maintain vulnerability remediation workflows to achieve >90% SecureLens compliance.
  • Enable PAM authentication across Kubernetes and supporting OS layers.
  • Ensure clusters and workloads meet cybersecurity, data privacy, and lifecycle compliance requirements.
  • Support audits and remediate non‑compliant configurations.
  • Drive the transition from CentOS to supported and approved OS platforms.

Automation, Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Automate repetitive operational tasks, cluster provisioning, workload deployment, configuration, and compliance enforcement.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps, automation frameworks, and standard reference designs.
  • Participate in EPIC initiatives to reduce complexity and increase efficiency.
  • Assist with PPDM migrations for Kubernetes‑based backup workloads.
  • Contribute to patch testing frameworks using canary/ring deployment models.

Platform 3 / CCOE Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with CCOE intake, design, and fulfillment teams to deliver frictionless onboarding.
  • Ensure Kubernetes solutions align with lifecycle, security, and platform standards.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions to extend platform knowledge across Cox.
  • Participate in customer feedback loops, roadshows, and product management routines.
  • Provide timely support for Rancher migrations and eventual decommissioning.

AI & GPU Platform Support

  • Support deployment of GPU‑enabled Kubernetes clusters.
  • Implement automation for provisioning GPU workloads.
  • Validate ServiceNow intake workflows for AI-native tenant designs.

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.
  • Develop and publish right‑sizing audit reports for cluster optimization and cost efficiency.
  • Track cluster capacity, growth, and licensing/tool usage.
  • Participate in monthly operational reviews.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Kubernetes engineering, platform engineering, or cloud‑native infrastructure roles.
  • Hands‑on experience with some Kubernetes distributions (RKE2, AKS, EKS, GKE, VMware Tanzu, or upstream).
  • Experience with Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Experience with OpenLens and other K8s management tools.
  • Strong understanding of container orchestration, container runtimes, registries, and image security.
  • Expertise with infrastructure automation and configuration management (Terraform, Ansible, FluxCD/ArgoCD, Helm).
  • Experience with Linux system administration and OS‑level troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of networking concepts (CNI, load balancers, service mesh, DNS, ingress/egress).
  • Experience with CSI persistent storage solutions and cluster storage migrations.
  • Knowledge of DevOps tooling: CI/CD, GitOps, monitoring/observability, vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience implementing Zero Trust and cybersecurity controls in production environments.
  • Ability to collaborate across cross‑functional teams and communicate complex technical concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS).
  • Experience with GKE and enterprise virtualization platforms.
  • Experience designing Kubernetes platforms for AI/GPU workloads.

title: Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Descrição da vaga

Trabalhar na Norsul é fazer parte da maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — e contribuir, todos os dias, com o que mantém essa estrutura viva, confiável e em movimento.

Mesmo fora do mar, você está a bordo: garantindo que processos funcionem, decisões aconteçam e a operação siga com consistência, segurança e cuidado.

Aqui, o impacto não está só nos navios — está também em cada planilha, em cada conversa, em cada escolha feita com atenção e responsabilidade.

O que você entrega faz diferença. E o jeito como você entrega também.

Porque na Norsul, pertender é saber que sua atuação ajuda a sustentar um negócio essencial para o país — e uma cultura feita por gente que se importa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuação em embarcações, realizando toda a gestão de segurança dos navios;
  • Acompanhamento das agendas, documentações de segurança e gestão de EPI’s e uniformes;
  • Rotina de visitas aos navios e interface com a tripulação;
  • Promover inspeções nos navios identificando condições perigosas;
  • Controlar a implantação dos Programas de Gerenciamento de Riscos (PGR);
  • Preparar programas de treinamento sobre segurança do trabalho;
  • Analisar as ocorrências de Acidente de Trabalho;
  • Efetuar controle das informações referentes aos certificados para utilização dos EPIs;
  • Revisão e análise dos procedimentos internos relacionados à segurança do trabalho;
  • Prestar apoio à SIPAT, organizando as atividades e recursos necessários.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Técnico de Segurança, com registro ativo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (rotina de viagens para visitas às embarcações);
  • Experiência no segmento de navegação / offshore será considerado um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que oferecemos

  • Plano de saúde e odonto
  • Wellhub (atividade física e bem-estar)
  • Atendimento psicológico (Telavita)
  • Nutricionista
  • Shiatsu
  • Ticket alimentação/refeição
  • Cultura de desenvolvimento contínuo
  • Programas internos de reconhecimento e cuidado
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day off de aniversário

Fazer parte

É mais do que estar na maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — é fazer parte de um time que cuida do que faz e de quem faz acontecer.

Aqui, as relações importam. O respeito, a escuta e o apoio entre as pessoas são parte do trabalho, todos os dias.

Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria.

A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório.

Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua.

Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável.

Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto.

Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Cada pessoa importa. Cada trajetória tem valor.

Toda escala, travessia ou rotina é vivida com respeito e presença — e é isso que sustenta tudo o que a gente entrega.

Se esse jeito de trabalhar faz sentido pra você, o próximo embarque pode ser o seu!

description:
About The Job

We are looking for a backend software engineer to help build out a world-class travel portal for users as part of our Hopper Technology Solutions group.

You will work as part of a cross-functional team of exceptional engineers, designers and product managers to bring new features to market and provide best in class support for our partners to scale our joint business. A successful candidate loves to build and demonstrates high ownership about outcomes, and constantly looks for and finds creative ways to deliver quality results quickly. They can distinguish between what has to be right from the start and what can be iterated on.

Tech Stack

  • Our backend systems are written in Scala, and we use a suite of GCP services
  • Our frontends are web apps using react + typescript

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Design, build and operate API and full-stack solutions
  • Operate autonomously but work closely with your fellow engineers as well as designer/PM to ensure high alignment
  • Explore engineering improvements for the team and the product
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with the product team, other Hopper teams and external partner teams
  • Our group operates with very few meetings and emphasizes strong alignment and asynchronous decision making.

An ideal candidate has

  • A natural drive to fearlessly deep dive into an unknown code base while keeping their eyes on the goal to deliver results fast
  • Strong product thinking: their conception of quality is anchored in the customer

Experience with, or a willingness to learn, distributed system development in Scala.

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR-offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

DESCRIÇÃO

Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil?

Há mais de 39 anos no mercado, o Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas, presente em mais de 20 estados, formado por 4 marcas com a colaboração de 2100 colaboradores e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil. Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível. Acreditamos que o atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que se relacionam conosco.

O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Realiza coleta dos materiais nos consultórios para esterilização diária e guarda em lugar específico, para utilização dos profissionais / Dentistas; realiza a Limpeza e higienização dos consultórios (cadeiras, cuspideiras, entre outros itens) e confere diariamente os equipamentos (consultórios, central de esterilização/autoclaves) a fim de que estejam em perfeito funcionamento, comunicando irregularidades ao responsável imediato e formalizando solicitações de manutenção junto ao movdesk (ferramenta específica da empresa). Realiza as atividades seguindo as regras de segurança do trabalho e garantindo atendimento às normas de fiscalização e vigilância sanitária. Recepciona pacientes no consultório dentário, procurando identificá-las e averiguar suas necessidades, para prestar informações ou encaminhá-las ao cirurgião-dentista. Executa tarefas auxiliares ao trabalho do cirurgião-dentista, visando a agilização dos serviços. Auxilia o profissional no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas como segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos, manipular material provisório e definitivo utilizado para restauração dentária. Prepara o material anestésico, de sutura, polimento, bem como procede à troca de brocas, separa o material e instrumentos clínicos em bandejas para serem utilizados pelo profissional. Zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondicionar e esterilizar materiais e equipamentos utilizados. Colaborar com a limpeza e organização do local de trabalho (consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção). Realizar o controle dos materiais no estoque, solicitar materiais via sistema, cotação e compra dos materiais emergenciais para a clínica. Executar outras atividades correlatas ao cargo e/ou determinadas pelo superior.

  • Windows Server: Administração de Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) e WSUS.

title: Global Process Data Consultant/Lead
description:
Overview

Global Process Data Consultant/Lead • Rio de Janeiro, BR

Job Description: Global Process Data Consultant/Lead

Duration: 7 months

100% Remote opportunity within USA and Brazil

Position Purpose

  • Currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.
  • Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference, conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business processes. This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and adoption.
  • The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.

Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

  • Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned to standardized value stream processes.
  • Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for S/4HANA.
  • Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies.
  • Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return) Functional Process

Data Ownership Responsibilities

  • Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.
  • Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.
  • Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.

Data Migration & Readiness

  • Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.
  • Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.
  • Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.

Data Governance & Standards

  • Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.
  • Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.
  • Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.
  • Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.

Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

  • Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.
  • Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.
  • Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).
  • Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.
  • Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.
  • Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.
  • Technical & Functional Skills
  • Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).
  • Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.
  • Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.
  • Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).
  • Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.

Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.
  • Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.
  • Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.
  • Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

title: Roaming IREG Engineer - Lisbon-based
description:
Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented Roaming IREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services. We are looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

This is a Lisbon-based position, and relocation will be required. Relocation support may be provided for the selected candidate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming)
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Maintain close relationships with external partners like carriers and service providers

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will impact the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: Collaborate with leaders and external advisors in a dynamic environment
  • Dynamic Work Environment: A collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged
  • Professional Development: Enhance your skills in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world
  • Open Communication Culture: An environment where ideas are heard and dialogue is encouraged
  • Get Things Done Attitude: A results-driven team that values impact

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment.

About SBM Offshore

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

As Offshore Maintenance Engineer, you are responsible for managing the maintenance activities within an offshore unit, ensuring that all tasks are aligned with the unit’s operational goals and regulatory requirements. This role involves planning and mobilizing resources, coordinating with various stakeholders, and ensuring the quality and efficiency of maintenance activities. You play a key role in maintaining the unit’s operational integrity by managing the maintenance backlog, participating in procurement processes, and supporting both corrective and planned maintenance efforts.

Responsibilities

  • You manage the maintenance backlog for the offshore unit, ensuring timely and effective resolution of outstanding tasks.
  • You participate in the planning of backlog management, addressing both short-term and long-term maintenance needs for the unit.
  • You align with the Maintenance Superintendent and Supervisors to develop and execute strategies for backlog management.
  • You implement the maintenance strategy as outlined by the department Lead and Manager.
  • You plan and mobilize resources for major maintenance activities and third-party services, ensuring all necessary personnel and equipment are available.
  • Collaborate with Fabric Maintenance and SPIE teams to guarantee the execution of their respective scopes.
  • You oversee the execution of routine maintenance offshore, ensuring that tasks are completed on time and within budget.
  • You update and maintain the unit’s maintenance budget master plan, providing regular reports on progress and expenditures.
  • You ensure corrective maintenance tasks are properly logged in the system and closely monitor the unit’s maintenance KPIs.
  • You participate in the development and execution of planned shutdowns, contributing to the scope of work and ensuring smooth operations.
  • You ensure that offshore supervisors and superintendents are compliant with SBM procedures when performing their duties.
  • You support the procurement process flow, ensuring that all necessary materials and services are acquired efficiently.

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You’ll Work With

The Data Ops team is focused on delivering high-quality, auditable data to our customers. You will work within a team dedicated to reducing customer effort and empowering clients to take actionable insights from their private markets data.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Data Ops Analyst, you will be responsible for the lifecycle of quarterly data extraction and client reporting. Your primary objective is to ensure that extracted data is high-quality, timely, and actionable for our customers.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Quarterly Data Extraction: Manage the extraction of private markets data from accounting documents and performance reports.
  • Quality & Timeliness: Ensure all data is extracted in a timely manner and meets our high standards for data quality.
  • Customer Support: Provide timely and accurate front-line support for all customers that your segment services.
  • Active Engagement: Proactively follow up with clients during each quarterly data campaign, providing clear tracking of what data is complete and ready for client review.
  • Real-time Interaction: Engage with clients in real-time via phone or Zoom to resolve issues and guide them through their data.
  • Process Improvement: Keep detailed documentation of client interactions to identify trends and drive operational and process improvements for the data ops team and the product teams.
  • Project Management: Treat every data campaign as a project, ensuring all stakeholders are updated on progress and milestones.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Become an expert in private markets data, including financial metrics and KPIs.

About You

  • Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to articulate technical and complex concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  • Analytical Skills: Knowledge of financial statements and common financial concepts with a strong sense of curiosity to solve problems.
  • Organization: Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to balance multiple active projects with competing priorities.
  • Client Service: Care deeply and genuinely about client services; you exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable learning new technologies and platforms quickly in a fast-paced environment.

description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italianaante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Coordenador(a) de Projeto terá a responsabilidade de implementar o projeto Apoio a Distância na comunidade Morro dos Cabritos e executar as atividades referentes a esse programa. Além disso deverá participar dos eventos comunitários que serão realizados em parceria com uma empresa patrocinadora e executar ações pontuais de promoção social.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  • Apoiar a realização pontual de eventos comunitários que a AVSI está realizando em parceria com uma empresa patrocinadora.
  • Organizar o trabalho do projeto Apoio a Distância (SAD) que irá começar no Morro dos Cabritos, em Copacabana.
  • Elaborar diagnóstico social de famílias e comunidades em situação de vulnerabilidade e promover a elaboração, implementação e monitoramento de planos de acompanhamento familiar.
  • Promover o acesso a direitos sociais e políticas públicas (assistência, saúde, educação, habitação).
  • Articular as famílias com a rede socioassistencial e intersetorial (CRAS, CREAS, escolas, unidades de saúde, Judiciário).
  • Elaborar relatórios sociais, pareceres técnicos e estudos de caso.
  • Planejar e executar ações socioeducativas e preventivas.
  • Acompanhar e monitorar indicadores sociais ligados à realização dos planos de acompanhamento familiar.

Overview

Em menos de um ano, a Light Conecta mostrou que veio para revolucionar o mercado de serviços ligados à energia. Nascida em setembro de 2024, a empresa surgiu com a missão de integrar soluções inovadoras e construir um futuro melhor. Começamos com apenas uma colaboradora e, em poucos meses, dezenas de vidas foram conectadas e iluminadas pela força que não se apaga. Em dezembro de 2024, já éramos 230 colaboradores brilhantes, iniciando oficialmente nossa operação.

Sob a liderança inspiradora de Antonio Queiroz , nosso gerente geral, a Light Conecta se fortaleceu como símbolo de resiliência, propósito e transformação. Antonio trouxe visão, humanidade e estratégia, guiando cada passo com sabedoria e paixão.

Hoje, somos mais do que uma empresa: somos um movimento. Um espaço onde cada pessoa é luz, e cada conexão é uma oportunidade de fazer a diferença. Com criatividade, inovação e colaboração, construímos soluções que impactam positivamente a sociedade e iluminam o caminho para um futuro melhor.

A Light Conecta é uma empresa de integração de serviços no mercado de energia. Embora a Light SESA seja seu principal cliente, ela não é o único. Atuamos com soluções que vão desde utilities (serviços essenciais como ligações novas e atendimentos emergenciais) até contratos de climatização e eficiência energética para clientes como a Marinha e shoppings. Nosso posicionamento é claro: se o problema é com energia, a Light tem a solução , seja via Light COM, Light Energia ou Light Conecta.

Principais serviços:

  • Utilities: corte de clientes, ligações novas, atendimentos emergenciais.
  • Eficiência energética e climatização.
  • Conservação de energia elétrica.
  • Expansão para serviços de data center e facilities.

Diferenciais:

  • Proximidade com a distribuidora.
  • Flexibilidade regulatória.
  • Agilidade e qualidade sem as amarras regulatórias da distribuidora.

Em apenas 10 meses, já contamos com cerca de 700 colaboradores . Nosso plano é triplicar o faturamento nos próximos três anos e, em cinco anos, crescer até quatro vezes, ampliando contratos de longo prazo e aumentando a proporção de clientes externos. Estamos expandindo para climatização de ambientes e novos mercados como saneamento, pequeno comércio e indústria.

A Light Conecta é prova de que inovação, agilidade e qualidade podem caminhar juntas . Em pouco tempo, tornou-se referência em prestação de serviços e continua crescendo com foco, excelência e brilho próprio.

Juntos, somos a energia que move a mudança!

Summary of the Role

As a Social-First Customer Care Specialist, you will be the first point of contact for users across social channels (public comments and DMs) and email. You’ll support customers of a leading digital subscription-based product suite and help maintain a positive brand presence by responding to customer questions, resolving issues, and escalating when needed.

description:
Consultor(a) Digital de Inteligência Regulatória - Volt Robotics

Apoiar a Diretoria de Inteligência Regulatória da Volt Robotics na interpretação aprofundada, estruturação e aplicação das normas setoriais do setor elétrico e de infraestrutura, assegurando que o entendimento regulatório seja incorporado de forma consistente às análises, modelos, soluções baseadas em dados e inteligência artificial. O objetivo do cargo é transformar dados regulatórios complexos em suporte técnico qualificado à tomada de decisão, ao desenvolvimento de estratégias regulatórias, à mitigação de riscos e à identificação de oportunidades para clientes e para a própria Volt.

2 Descrição Geral

Esta função integra a Diretoria de Inteligência Regulatória da Volt Robotics, atuando na interface entre regulação setorial, análise de dados e inovação tecnológica. O(a) consultor(a) é responsável por interpretar e aplicar normas, leis, resoluções e diretrizes regulatórias — especialmente do setor elétrico e de outros setores de infraestrutura — no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas, automatizações e aplicações de inteligência artificial.

Sua atuação envolve a condução de análises regulatórias aplicadas, a tradução de requisitos normativos em insumos técnicos para projetos e produtos da Volt. Além disso, também irá fornecer apoio estratégico à identificação de riscos, oportunidades regulatórias e novos modelos de negócio. O cargo atua de forma colaborativa com a Diretoria e com as equipes técnicas, contribuindo ativamente para a qualidade das entregas e para o posicionamento da Volt em temas regulatórios complexos.

3 Atribuições Principais

  • Analisar e interpretar legislações, normas, resoluções e demais instrumentos regulatórios aplicáveis aos projetos da Volt, avaliando seus impactos técnicos, operacionais e estratégicos;
  • Estruturar e validar análises regulatórias aplicadas a dados, modelos analíticos, automações e soluções de inteligência artificial desenvolvidas pela Volt;
  • Atuar na identificação de riscos, inconformidades e oportunidades regulatórias, propondo encaminhamentos técnicos e estratégicos para clientes e para a Diretoria;
  • Apoiar a concepção e o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, soluções e modelos de negócio, considerando requisitos e condicionantes regulatórias;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração de estudos, notas técnicas, relatórios, apresentações e materiais estratégicos utilizados em projetos e interações com clientes;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a manutenção de bases normativas, repositórios de conhecimento e padrões metodológicos da Diretoria de Inteligência Regulatória;
  • Orientar estagiários e profissionais mais juniores, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento técnico-regulatório da equipe.

4.1 Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Graduação completa em áreas relacionadas (Direito, Engenharia, Economia, Computação ou afins);
  • Conhecimento em regulação setorial, preferencialmente no setor elétrico;
  • Capacidade de interpretação de normas, legislações e documentos regulatórios complexos;
  • Experiência em análises técnicas ou regulatórias aplicadas;
  • Boa capacidade de organização, análise crítica e comunicação escrita;
  • Visão sistêmica e habilidade para trabalhar com grandes volumes de informação e identificar padrões de risco;
  • Inglês: capacidade de leitura e compreensão técnica, dado o fluxo de informações internacionais e tecnológicas.

4.2 Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia em consultoria regulatória;
  • Conhecimento em dados, automação ou aplicações de inteligência artificial;
  • Experiência em participação ou análise de processos regulatórios;
  • Familiaridade com ambientes regulados complexos e projetos multidisciplinares;
  • Experiência em gestão de processos.
  • Pensamento crítico e analítico, capaz de antecipar cenários e propor soluções;
  • Autonomia com responsabilidade técnica;
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e assertiva;
  • Postura colaborativa e orientação a soluções;
  • Adaptabilidade a ambientes regulatórios dinâmicos;
  • Proatividade e senso de dono sobre entregas;
  • Capacidade de aprendizado contínuo;

5. Por que a Volt?

  • Alta visibilidade perante o mercado
  • Oportunidade de se desenvolver ao lado de profissionais extremamente experientes
  • Local onde a sua autonomia será incentivada e reforçada.
  • Ambiente de trabalho que promove o respeito às pessoas.
  • Empresa atenta às inovações do mercado
  • Empresa preocupada com o sucesso do cliente
  • Qualidade e consistência das análises regulatórias: precisão técnica, coerência normativa e aplicabilidade prática das análises desenvolvidas;
  • Integração entre regulação, dados e tecnologia: capacidade de traduzir requisitos regulatórios em soluções analíticas, modelos e automatizações efetivas;
  • Geração de valor para clientes e para a Volt: contribuição para a mitigação de riscos, identificação de oportunidades e desenvolvimento de soluções e novos negócios;
  • Cumprimento de prazos e entregas: execução das atividades sob sua responsabilidade dentro dos prazos e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos;

Job description

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

description:
Overview

Product Designer TurnKey Tech Staffing•Rio de Janeiro, BR

Descrição da vaga

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.

Responsibilities

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champions a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.

Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.

Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.

title: Sr Business Development Manager, Flights LATAM
description:
About the job

As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration.

You will represent the company in day‑to‑day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills.

At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high‑growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market.

Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper’s value proposition and effectively position our products and capabilities to airline partners.

What your day‑to‑day would look like:

  • Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
  • Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
  • Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them
  • Help organize and participate in quarterly business reviews with airline partners
  • Partner with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue tracking for airline partnerships
  • Assist in developing and executing marketing initiatives and insertion orders (I/Os) with airline partners in support of growth goals
  • Support contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments in collaboration with senior team members
  • Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience
  • Develop a working knowledge of the global travel market, with a focus on airline industry dynamics.

An ideal candidate has

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management with a track record of supporting revenue growth
  • Prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, or airline), with exposure to or experience in the LATAM market preferred
  • Familiarity with commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the LATAM travel ecosystem
  • A positive, proactive, and self‑motivated attitude
  • Ability to prepare and deliver clear, data‑driven presentations
  • A collaborative, team‑first mindset
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
  • A detail‑oriented and analytical approach to problem‑solving
  • Passion for travel, technology, and digital commerce
  • Foundational value‑selling skills and commercial acumen
  • Comfort working in a fast‑paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English & Portuguese

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials..

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department

Strategy & Planning

Location

Brazil

The Position

Reporting to the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long‑lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
    1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
    2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGOs and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender‑based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
    3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post‑tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Your Profile

Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations

  • Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of working in women’s football in Brazil (and the wider Region) with clear links and networks to key women’s football stakeholders.

Legacy Development

Communication & Stakeholder Relations

Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience

  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);
  • Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar;
  • Acompanhar de forma permanente as atividades realizadas pela CIPA, estudando suas observações e propostas, visando a adoção das soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho e meio ambiente dela valendo-se como agente multiplicador;
  • Controlar, distribuir e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI);
  • Elaborar documentos de segurança do trabalho como Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, dentre outros;
  • Fazer inspeção em equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, recursos audiovisuais e didáticos e outros materiais considerados indispensáveis, de acordo com a legislação vigente;

  • Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios;
  • Comunicar os resultados de suas inspeções à coordenação do SESMT, elaborando relatórios;
  • Investigar acidentes ocorridos, examinando as condições da ocorrência, para identificar suas causas e propor as providências cabíveis;
  • Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados;

description:
SAP S/4HANA Security & Authorisation Manager Mars•Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Descrição da vaga

SAP S / 4HANA Security and Authorisation Manager | Digital Core Locations : Slough, UK - Sao Paolo, Brazil - Warsaw, Poland

As we work to transform and optimise Mars, a new program has been mobilised by the Mars leadership team. The program is focused on the design and implementation of SAP S / 4HANA in Mars across Segments (Petcare, Corporate, Snacking & Food). Much more than a simple “Lift and Shift,” this program will undertake a major process simplification and harmonisation scope as we digitally transform our business.

The program focuses primarily on eight mega process areas : Finance, Source to Pay (procurement and vendor mgmt.), Plan to Fulfil (manufacturing and distribution), Lead to Cash (sales order processing and payment), Governance, Engage to Consume (marketing), Idea to Market (R&D), and Recruit to Retire (HR). This transformation requires thought leadership, quality decision making, deep technical know-how, and an ability to navigate complex business challenges while applying a holistic and multi-disciplinary approach to each of these mega processes.

As part of the program, four new positions have been created to manage all core Security and Compliance activities related to the SAP S / 4HANA landscape.

Collectively the new roles will be responsible for the delivery of the core SAP Security deliverables within S / 4HANA and FIORI ensuring alignment with role design, processes and governance principles.

Key Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate and exemplify the Five Principles of Mars, Inc. personally and within the team.
  • Support the SAP Security team in ensuring that shared and local / segment template security requirements are adopted across business segments while incorporating segment-specific needs into the shared template or localising them as necessary.
  • Analyse and understand the security requirements and risks of a complex ERP environment that underpins critical business and IT processes.
  • Work with the SAP Security team and Global Process Owners (GPO’s) in implementing a comprehensive SAP Security and GRC framework, including strategies, policies, and procedures that align with organisational objectives and industry best practices to ensure robust access controls, risk management and regulatory compliance.
  • Design and deliver technical and functional solutions against specifications in accordance with agreed standards and procedures.
  • Follow standards and procedure for user provisioning, de-provisioning, and segregation of duties.
  • Lead and support multiple testing phases – including build unit tests (BUT) security unit tests (SUT) system integration tests (SIT) and user acceptance tests (UAT) by leveraging Mars current test tools to ensure robust SAP security and system integrity.
  • Collaborate effectively within a diverse team that fosters an inclusive culture, ensuring all contributions are valued and recognised.
  • Stay informed on emerging security threats and apply industry best practices to strengthen SAP application security and controls.

Context and Scope

Programs are often marked by a seamless transition from the old system / landscape to the new one. As part of this SAP S / 4HANA Digital Transformation program, we require someone with high-level expertise and experience in SAP Security & Authorisations in S / 4HANA including FIORI.

The successful candidate will support the delivery of the security scope and collaborate with counterparts at Mars (i.e. Petcare, Corporate, Snacking and Food) to capture and analyse authorisation requirements and security related activities.

Education and Professional

10+ years in SAP Security and Authorisations with at least three full life cycle implementations in S / 4HANA and FIORI.

Professional certification such as SAP Certified Technology Professional, SAP Access Control 12.0, or other relevant security certifications.

Knowledge and Experience

Possess deep expertise in SAP S / 4HANA security and authorisations including role design administration and integration with FIORI.

Proficiency in security design, configuration, testing and deployment across key technologies including SAP S / 4HANA, Fiori and SAP Master Data Governance (MDG).

Strong understanding of authorisation concepts for S / 4 HANA including FIORI, Business Technology Platform (BTP) and other Cloud applications such SuccessFactors, Ariba, & SAP MDG.

Deep knowledge of SOX compliance, segregation of duties (SoD), GDPR, and other relevant regulatory requirements.

Excellent understanding of S / 4HANA product roadmap.

Highly organised with proven experience in setting and managing deadlines across diverse stakeholder groups while ensuring clear ownership and accountability for all activities.

Demonstrates a strong team player mindset with a drive to develop new professional skills combined with proactive, growth oriented and goal-focused approach to work.

Excellent documentation, visualisation and presentation skills.

Advanced knowledge of Microsoft office tools particularly PowerPoint and Excel with expertise in building complex formulas, developing pivot tables and creating data-driven reports and presentations.

Experience working with System and Business Integrators.

Ability to work under pressure and maintain a professional manner.

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.

Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.

Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.

An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.
